app.name: PDF Toolkit
app.tagline: Fast, private PDF tools that run entirely on your device.

merge.title: Merge PDF
merge.description: Combine multiple PDF files into a single document.

split.title: Split PDF
split.description: Split a PDF by every page, ranges, or selected ranges.

extract.title: Extract Pages
extract.description: Create a new PDF from selected pages, such as 1-4,8,11-15.

remove.title: Remove Pages
remove.description: Delete selected pages and save a new PDF.

rotate.title: Rotate Pages
rotate.description: Rotate all or selected pages by 90°, 180°, or 270°.

reorder.title: Reorder Pages
reorder.description: Rearrange pages in a drag-and-drop thumbnail grid.

images-to-pdf.title: Images to PDF
images-to-pdf.description: Turn JPG, PNG, and WebP images into a single PDF.

pdf-to-images.title: PDF to Images
pdf-to-images.description: Export pages as PNG or JPG at a chosen DPI and quality.

watermark.title: Watermark PDF
watermark.description: Stamp text or an image with full Arabic text support.

page-numbers.title: Page Numbers
page-numbers.description: Add page numbers with position, range, and size options.

protect.title: Protect PDF
protect.description: Encrypt a PDF with a password you choose.

unlock.title: Unlock PDF
unlock.description: Remove protection using a password you already know.

home.title: All tools
home.subtitle: Everything runs offline. Your files never leave this computer.
home.privacy: Files are processed locally on your device.

tool.comingSoon: This tool is being built. It will be available in a later phase.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Change the interface language. The layout flips for right-to-left languages.
settings.privacyBody: PDF Toolkit processes files locally. There are no uploads, no cloud conversions, and no analytics that include your file names or contents.
settings.aboutBody: PDF Toolkit is a local-first, offline desktop utility for Windows.

toolUi.pagesHelp: Use commas between pages and hyphens for ranges: 1,4,7 or 1-4,8,11-15.
toolUi.reorderHint: Drag pages to rearrange them, then save.
toolUi.unlockWarning: Enter the password you already know. This tool never guesses or bypasses passwords.
